assessed_skill: Classify chronic kidney disease by GFR and albuminuria category from serial laboratory measurements.

review.question_for_reviewer: 兩版題目是否都足以判定 G、A 分級？台灣版的「尿白蛋白與肌酸酐比值」是否符合你在病歷或檢驗單上慣用的名稱？

variants.question: 一位成人在門診追蹤，近四個月病況穩定。四個月前的估算腎絲球過濾率（eGFR）為 54 mL/min/1.73 m²，這次為 52 mL/min/1.73 m²。兩次都採晨起第一次尿液檢驗，尿白蛋白與肌酸酐比值（UACR）分別為 78 與 84 mg/g。依 KDIGO 2024 年慢性腎臟病指引，病歷上應記錄哪一組 G、A 分級？
variants.rationale: 兩次檢查相隔四個月，eGFR 都落在 G3a 的 45–59 mL/min/1.73 m² 範圍。兩次 UACR 都屬中度增加（A2），因此記錄為 G3a、A2。

variants.question: An adult seen in clinic has been clinically stable for four months. The estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) was 54 mL/min/1.73 m² four months ago and is 52 mL/min/1.73 m² today. The urine albumin-to-creatinine ratios (UACRs) on first-morning samples at those visits were 78 and 84 mg/g, respectively. Which GFR and albuminuria categories should be documented under the 2024 KDIGO guideline for chronic kidney disease?
variants.rationale: At visits four months apart, both eGFR values fall in the G3a range of 45–59 mL/min/1.73 m². Both UACRs fall in the moderately increased range (A2), giving a classification of G3a, A2.

evidence.title: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of Chronic Kidney Disease
evidence.locator: Printed page S137. Table 1, minimum duration for CKD. Table 2, G3a row and GFR column (mL/min per 1.73 m²). Table 3, A2 row and ACR column in mg/g.
evidence.anchor_format: Category and value from each identified row, joined by a vertical bar. Rows are separated by LF. SHA-256 covers the UTF-8 anchor.

evidence.title: Combining GFR and Albuminuria to Classify CKD Improves Prediction of ESRD
evidence.locator: Abstract, HUNT 2 cohort, sentence reporting the multivariable survival analysis.
evidence.scope: 這項挪威成人世代研究說明，同時記錄 eGFR 與白蛋白尿有助於評估腎衰竭風險。本題的分級界值取自上列 KDIGO 指引。
evidence.anchor_format: Verbatim substring of abstract. SHA-256 covers the UTF-8 anchor.
evidence.anchor: estimated GFR (eGFR) and albuminuria were independently and strongly associated with progression to ESRD
